points_en: Labor's government in Australia's Victoria state was defeated after 12 years.
The Liberal-National coalition won Saturday's state election.
Jess Wilson, 36, a Liberal leader, is set to become the new premier.
caption:
Victoria changes government after 12 years.

English: Australia's Victoria state has voted out the Labor government after 12 years. The Liberal-National coalition won Saturday's election, according to ABC. Jess Wilson, 36, is set to become the new premier.

नेपाली: अस्ट्रेलियाको भिक्टोरिया राज्यमा १२ वर्षपछि लेबर सरकार पराजित भएको छ। शनिबारको निर्वाचनमा लिबरल–नेसनल गठबन्धनले जित हासिल गरेको एबीसीले जनाएको छ। ३६ वर्षीया जेस विल्सन नयाँ प्रिमियर बन्ने भएकी छन्।
